items.title: Nirvana to Receive Video Vanguard Award at 2026 VMAs
items.summary:
MTV will give Nirvana the Video Vanguard Award at the 2026 VMAs, handing the ceremony's career honor to a band that stopped recording more than three decades ago. Pitchfork reported the award, which follows recent recipients Mariah Carey in 2025, Katy Perry in 2024, Shakira in 2023 and Nicki Minaj in 2022.

Nirvana ended with Kurt Cobain's death in 1994. Since then the surviving members — Dave Grohl, Krist Novoselic and Pat Smear — have reconvened only for occasional one-off performances, typically with guest vocalists filling Cobain's role.

The template was set in 2014, when the band was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame and brought out Joan Jett, Kim Gordon, St. Vincent and Lorde to sing the songs. Grohl, Novoselic and Smear most recently played together in 2025 at the Fire Aid benefit concert in Los Angeles.

The 2026 VMAs will air live from Los Angeles on Sunday, Sept. 27. CBS carries the broadcast, with a simulcast on Paramount+ and on MTV, the show's original home. MTV has not named a host, and the full nominee list is already out.

items.title: Michael Kelly Joins ‘Landman’ For Season 3 As Series Regular
items.summary:
Michael Kelly has joined the third season of Paramount+'s Landman as a series regular, according to Deadline. He will play William Crockett, described as the head of the world's largest oil management firm — a figure the production characterizes as a titan of industry whose bearing is all efficiency and money.

Kelly comes to the show from other corners of the same broad universe of prestige television, with recent credits including Lioness and The Penguin. He is represented by WME, Liebman Entertainment and Schreck Rose Dapello.

Landman, set in the boomtowns of West Texas, is drawn from the 11-part podcast Boomtown and follows both the roughnecks on the rigs and the wildcat billionaires above them. Billy Bob Thornton leads the cast as Tommy Norris, alongside Demi Moore, Andy Garcia, Ali Larter and Sam Elliott, with Jacob Lofland, Michelle Randolph, Paulina Chávez, Kayla Wallace, Mark Collie, James Jordan and Colm Feore also appearing.

Season 2 pushed Norris toward a breaking point under pressure from M-Tex Oil, Demi Moore's Cami Miller and his own family. No plot details for Season 3 have been made public.

Taylor Sheridan executive produces with David C. Glasser, David Hutkin, Ron Burkle, Bob Yari, Christian Wallace, Thornton, Geyer Kosinski, Michael Friedman and Stephen Kay, along with Dan Friedkin and Jason Hoch for Imperative Entertainment and J.K. Nickell and Megan Creydt for Texas Monthly.

items.title: Jalen Brunson To Host ‘SNL’ Season 52 Premiere; Dakota Johnson, Shane Gillis & Inde Navarrette Also Set For Studio 8H
items.summary:
Jalen Brunson will host the Season 52 premiere of Saturday Night Live on September 26, making his debut at Studio 8H a few months after leading the Knicks to their first championship in more than 50 years. The Finals MVP joins a short list of NBA players who have hosted the show, among them Charles Barkley, Michael Jordan and LeBron James. Katseye will make their first appearance as musical guest, arriving off the new EP Wild and their ongoing Wildworld tour.

Deadline reported that NBC has also locked the three episodes that follow. Dakota Johnson hosts October 3 for her third time, promoting the film Verity, with Baltimore hardcore band Turnstile making their SNL debut while out on Never Enough Tour Part 2.

Shane Gillis returns October 10, also for a third turn as host. The comedian was hired to the cast in 2019 and fired before he ever appeared on air; since then Netflix has renewed his workplace comedy Tires for a fourth season and he sold out two nights at Philadelphia's Lincoln Financial Field. Rosalía will perform, her second time on the show.

The October 31 episode goes to Inde Navarrette, the Obsession star, in her hosting debut. She has recently booked roles in the new X-Men film and The Waffle House Index. Gracie Abrams is the musical guest, back for a second appearance following her third album, Daughter from Hell.

Broadway Video produces Saturday Night Live in association with NBC, with Lorne Michaels as executive producer. Hosts and musical guests beyond Halloween have not been announced.

items.title: Conor Oberst Announces Debut Short Film Invention 13
items.summary:
Conor Oberst has made a film. The Bright Eyes frontman co-directed a 15-minute short called Invention 13 with Shawn Foree, and it premieres at Beyond Fest in Los Angeles on September 26.

Consequence reported that the pair shot the film on Super 16mm over four cold nights in Omaha this past January, working with a 40-person crew and building the picture out of practical effects and hand-drawn animation. The story follows a pianist struggling against a run of strange obstacles while trying to master J.S. Bach's Invention No. 13, the piece that gives the film its title.

Emory Cohen, who played Homer on The OA, stars alongside newcomer Olivia Howard and professional skateboarder Nelly Morville. Bright Eyes multi-instrumentalist Nathaniel Walcott wrote the score, and Phoebe Bridgers appears as a voice actor.

The premiere screening takes place at Hollywood's Egyptian Theatre, paired with Nobuhiko Obayashi's 1977 Japanese horror film Hausu. Oberst and Foree will take part in a Q&A afterward, moderated by comedian and musician Whitmer Thomas.

Bright Eyes tour the US this fall with the reunited Lullaby for the Working Class, whose members include Walcott and Mike Mogis, running from Milwaukee on October 2 through a hometown date at Omaha's Admiral Theater on October 20. In January 2027 the band plays three nights at the Brooklyn Paramount performing I'm Wide Awake, It's Morning and Digital Ash in a Digital Urn in full, extending the anniversary program they staged this year at Red Rocks and the Hollywood Bowl. A third such show at Forest Hills Stadium was cut short by rain.

items.title: Robert Pattinson’s ‘Primetime’ to Open Beyond Fest
items.summary:
Beyond Fest will open with Primetime, Lance Oppenheim's A24 film starring Robert Pattinson, giving the picture its West Coast premiere at the Director's Village after its bow in Venice. The cast includes Merritt Wever, Skyler Gisondo, Phoebe Bridgers and former CNN chief Jeff Zucker, who plays himself.

The Hollywood Reporter detailed the full lineup for the Los Angeles genre festival, which runs September 23 through October 8 and includes ten world premieres. Among them are V/H/S/MIXTAPE from RZA, Flying Lotus and Ernest Dickerson, RZA's Saturday Afternoon Kung-Fu Theater Born Invincible series, and a screening of Nobuhiko Obayashi's Hausu paired with Conor Oberst's short Invention 13.

Also programmed: Alex Gibney's Musk, Bassam Tariq's Your Mother, Your Mother, Your Mother, Sung Kang's Drifter, Mike P. Nelson's Beware Buouna, Jordan Downey's The Cycle, and Victorian Psycho from Zachary Wigon and Maika Monroe, which stood out at Cannes. Mike Flanagan brings two episodes of his Carrie series, and Robert Eggers will show first material from Werwulf alongside repertory screenings of The Witch, The Lighthouse and The Northman. Restorations include Ken Russell's The Devils and a slate of 4K work.

"Beyond Fest has always existed to erase the false borders between arthouse and grindhouse, the brand new and the gloriously rediscovered," head of programming Evrim Ersoy said in a statement, calling this year's slate "a maximalist celebration of cinema in every form."

In-person guests include M. Night Shyamalan, who gets a retrospective, Danny DeVito for a screening of Hoffa, plus Al Pacino, Jamie Lee Curtis, Bruce Dern, Matt Berry, Michael Mann and Dolph Lundgren.
